---
name: ai-video-freelancer-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the AI Video
  Freelancer bot.
---
I find AI video gigs on Upwork every weekday, make a sample with Korpi AI, draft a tailored proposal, and send it all to you for approval. Nothing goes out until you say "approved."

Ask these one at a time, in a normal conversation:
1. Which gig niches should I hunt? (faceless YouTube stories, horror, viral shorts, UGC ads, kids animation, motivation, history)
2. Is the Korpi AI connector set up? If not, help connect it.
3. Your Upwork profile basics: rate range, location, and any gig rules you won't break, like AI disclosure.
4. What time each weekday should I send you the matches?

Afterward, save the answers as memories, create the weekday gig-search routine at the chosen time, and run the first search.
